reviews.comment: I loved this woman! she rocks! take the class with her if you can!

I took Dr. Harty for BIOL 213 (wasn't listed as a a course option on here). She is an amazing professor and really engages the class. It's impossible to go to one of her lectures and not feel inspired to learn more. I typically struggle with biology, but she made everything make sense, an ability that few professors are capable of. I love her

I took Dr. Harty again this semester for BIOL 112. Her lectures are great, and tests align with lectures and homework. If you attend lectures and answer "pop quiz" questions you will get extra credit. This course was definitely a lot of memorization. One thing I would say is it was a bit unorganized as homework, study guides, etc. were posted late.

Dr. Harty was very engaging, overall a great professor. She offers a lot of extra credit, so if you miss an opportunity theres always going to be another chance to get all of the available points. She really wants to see her students succeed, so go to office hours if you need extra help or have a question.

HOLY MOLY, Dr. Harty was so amazing. I have never had a professor know me by first name and care so much for me that my grade actually improved. Granted, Dr. Harty isn't afraid to say it like it is and her lectures are very down to earth and she gives great feedback. Her exams aren't hard and as long as you look at the lecture notes you are fine

Had her for BIOL 111 and BIOL 112. She is very passionate about teaching and thoroughly explain the concepts to students. She provides extra credit, tests are straight-forward: pay attention, do the problem sets, and review the notes. Issues: cancels classes and doesn't provide materials in timely manner, and doesn't respond to emails.

Best prof I've ever had. Has engaging lectures and cares about the subject. Go to office hours,even if it isn't to ask a question related to class. She will go the extra mile to help students who put in effort and are polite. She's a newer prof so is still learning and getting better every semester. i recommend her esp. if you're a STEM major

Overall pretty bad professor. She's rude, lazy, and makes a ton of careless mistakes. But she's pretty smart and knows what she's talking about, and her tests are really easy (just study the slides and the past questions). Random extra credit for attending class, 4 tests, 10 labs, and lots of homework. But overall doable class if you study a lot.

Dr. Harty was alright. Her emails and chats in the GroupMe were rude. She sound passive-aggressive all the time and shows attitude. If she doesn't want to reply to your email, she won't...even if its an emergency. Take someone else. The only reason I took her is cuz she had Monday and Wednesday classes, and I wanted Friday off.

Dr. Harty was the best professor and teacher that I have ever had. She is excited about what she teaches, she loves to help, and is just overall a great professor and person. She had lots of office hours and she genuinely wants you to do well in the class. She is engaging and always is ready to help. It would be a mistake not to take her class.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I had Dr Harty for bio 111 and 112. There is extra credit given, which is very helpful towards your final grade, and as long as you do the problem sets, pay attention, and show up to lab you should be able to get an A. The only issue I had was that she stopped giving practice exams which had a big effect on my grade, but her study guides are useful
Easy class - if you try. Test reviews and problem sets get you well prepared for exams.

Dr. Harty is probably the best professor I have had at A&M so far. Her lectures aren't boring and are so easy to understand, I never had to look at the textbook or online for clarification. She also is very caring about every student. I really recommend her, I think it would be easy to get a good grade in this class if you just try your best.

I had Professor Harty her first semester at TAMU and I was nervous at first, but she is amazing. Her study guides and practice exams are extremely good resources for studying as well as the weekly problem sets. Her lectures can get boring, but she highlights the important details for exams. She was my first choice for BIOL112 this semester.

I had Mrs. Harty last semester for Biol 111 and she was fantastic. Use her practice exams, attend lectures, and go over her slides and you are bound to get an A on any of her exams. She's funny and actually takes the time to learn some of the student's names in her lecture which is cool. Needless to say, I'm taking her again for Biol 112.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Having Dr. Harty as one of my first college professors, she made my first semester experience amazing. Her lectures were extremely informative and her practice exams helped so much for the real exams. The amount of work was very manageable, and I was able to do very well without even touching the textbook. I highly recommend picking her!

Professor Harty was one of my favorite professors this semester as she always showed interest in what she was teaching and made her lectures interesting for the students. However, the one downside was she does not reply to emails in a timely manner. Professor Harty wants to ensure that her students do well and she is a great professor.

She is super knowledgeable and very open to questions. She lectures every class and gives three tests, plus two lab exams. She was very patient and really wanted to help in any way she could. I loved her class, and I would recommend her to anyone that wants to dip their toes into Biology.

Professor Harty is extremely enthusiastic and obviously cares about her job. She is overall a good professor. I found however, her course to be a bit disorganized and some of the lectures tended to be all over the place. At times class felt a bit messy. But, the tests are over material we studied, and you definitely receive the grade you deserve.

Dr. Harty is very willing to help out all students, and tries to make her lectures interesting. She also makes her tests easy, with no trick questions, and provides practice tests and study guides for each test. Would definitely recommend!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Harty made biology very enjoyable. She cares about her students and even has many of their names memorized in a class of 350 students. She clearly enjoys biology and teaching very much.

Dr. Harty is by far my favorite professor at A&M, she is an amazing lecturer and really takes the time to make sure her students understand the information she gives them. Shes pretty accommodating and her class doesn't require an unreasonable amount of studying. Homework is light and tests are very related to the lecture content.

I absolutely loved Dr Harty. Lectures aren't mandatory but highly recommend going because you'll get better notes and be more prepared for tests. She is very thorough in her lectures and makes them interesting. Always ready to help if you're confused and is pretty chill.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The exams are more application based. You have to understand the material to do well. Dr Harty is very passionate in her lectures and she keeps things interesting. She is really good at keeping up on emails and answering questions if needed. She wants her students to be successful and gives them all of the necessary tools to do so.
